name: dependency-bump
description: Update one dependency and verify the repository.

tasks.title: Bump {{input.package}}
tasks.brief: Update {{input.package}} to the requested compatible version. Review the lockfile and changelog conventions without changing unrelated dependencies.

tasks.title: Verify the {{input.package}} bump
tasks.brief: Run the repository checks after the {{input.package}} update and fix only regressions caused by this bump.
